verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SSN validation as part of document verification flow (stripe-identity-docs-3), but evidence is thin on standalone no-document checks like national registry lookups or credit-header/database-only verification — SSN validation appears bundled with document capture rather than a document-free flow. Missing for 10: explicit documented database-only/no-document verification session type, national registry checks, credit-header data verification, and independent confirmation these work without a doc scan.
